chapter: Thomas, own bands and neighborhood clubs
title: Playing with Kid Thomas across the river
summary: Barnes explains how Thomas hired him after hearing him in Kelly's band, how Paul also joined, and Thomas's costumes and work.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: How about Kid Thomas? Did you play with Thomas?
Well, I played with Thomas a while. Yeah, I played with Thomas two or three times. I went with his band and left him. But I left Thomas on the county anymore. So far, the job was over at the river.
How did you come to play with him originally? How did you get together? Well, from Keller's, he liked his band. Oh, you heard Keller's Band play?
Yeah. He heard Keller's Band.
Did you go across the river with Keller?
Yeah. Well, most everything over the river with him. Most everything come through there.
Well, I guess you had connections over there. Harrison Barnes.
Well, yeah. Harrison Barnes was the Boston Band over there.
And Thomas came and heard Keller's Band and he heard you in the band.

Yeah, I heard me in the band. And that's why Thomas hired me a couple of times. And when I leave Keller's Band, I worked with Thomas. Then I and my brothers did work with Thomas. We worked there together. Him on sax and I'm on clown.
Oh, that was Paul. Paul. He played with Thomas too?
Yeah.
Well, what about Thomas? Did he carry on with monkey shines in those days?
Well, Thomas always was a fellow who would have all kinds of weights and skirts and hats and things on, you know? Monkey shines. So that gave him a whole lot of work, you know?
Did the other guys do that much?

No, just him. Just him. He was the only one. But his band was a big difference. He was just a lot of drummers. Well, I feel all together different. Like, I forgot this piano we were playing. We were calling. I don't see it all. Little Thomas was playing drums. That's it. Little Thomas was calling. And Lucci Roman was playing tramo.
Lucci? Lucci. Yeah, I know him.
He was playing tramo. He was playing tramo.
He's John Church now.
Well, I think Alton too is John Church.
He was playing tramo. Where did Thomas play? Did he get any work on this side at all in those times?

Well, Thomas didn't have any work on this side at all. All the time was to work with the down and shoot a bar. He went to all the way in the bar. It's true. He had pretty much that suit up. He was no bad nonny like he was bad.
Was it steady work in the same place or did he move around from different places? Different places. Different places. Was he loud?
Yeah. Thomas Thomas had a big band. He always had a full band. That's him.
And how did he play himself? Do he play pretty much like he does now?
